name: Restaurant Cafe Dahuam.202 in Gerlos
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Restaurant Café Dahuam.202 in Gerlos!**

Nestled in the heart of the **Zillertal Alps** in **Tirol**, this cozy mountain retreat invites you to savor authentic Tyrolean hospitality. Whether you're craving a hearty **Kaiserschmarrn** with fresh berries, a savory **Tiroler Gröstl**, or a comforting bowl of **Käsespätzle**, every dish is crafted with local ingredients and a touch of Alpine charm.

After your meal, warm up with a **Schnaps** or a steaming cup of **Tiroler Bergkäse** soup by the fireplace. The rustic ambiance, paired with breathtaking views of the surrounding peaks, makes this the perfect spot to relax after a day of hiking, skiing, or exploring the scenic beauty of **Gerlos** and the **Zillertal Valley**.

Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, **Mayrhofen**, and the **Ahornbahn**, Café Dahuam.202 is your ideal mountain escape—where tradition meets tranquility.

**Come for the food, stay for the views!** 🏔️✨
